name: Liberty Agile Retirement Annuity 2
description: Retirement savings, portfolio choice, lump sum, recurring contributions, Exact Income option
spec_notes: Agile is a lump-sum retirement annuity with flexible recurring investments and an optional Exact Income Fund allocation. The member joins the Lifestyle Retirement Annuity Fund. The maximum initial advice fee is 3% excluding VAT; no advice fee applies to transfers from another retirement annuity. The platform fee is tiered by aggregated investment value: 0.58% for R0-R1m, 0.35% for R1m-R3m, 0.23% for R3m-R10m and 0.12% above R10m. The annual_platform_fee_pct field records the maximum tier. Existing minimums of R15,000 lump sum or R500 monthly retained from the supplied file. Sources: Agile Product Range Summary; Agile Intermediary Remuneration Dimension; Liberty Retirement Range technical specification; UCount Liberty Investments Integration.

name: Liberty Evolve Retirement Annuity
description: Retirement savings, Capped Tracker, growth sharing, portfolio choice
spec_notes: A specified proportion of the single premium is allocated to the Evolve Capped Tracker for three years; returns are subject to the growth-sharing design. At the end of three years, that portion moves into an equivalent portfolio without growth sharing. Retirement benefits equal the investment value at retirement, subject to any investment performance guarantee and applicable tax. Evolve has a flat platform fee of 0.30% p.a. The supplied 1% advice-fee value is retained; the retrieved sources did not provide the full current remuneration table for this exact product. Sources: Evolve Product Range Summary; Evolve Retirement Benefit; UCount Liberty Investments Integration.

name: Evolve Investment Plan
description: Endowment, single premium, Capped Tracker, growth sharing, portfolio choice
spec_notes: The plan may be structured as an endowment or sinking fund and may be bundled into up to 10 policies. A specified portion is invested in the Capped Tracker for three years, after which it moves to the Top 40 Tracker or another selected portfolio. Up to seven portfolios may be selected and the minimum allocation per portfolio is R2,500. The flat platform fee is 0.30% p.a. The maximum ongoing advice fee is 0.50% p.a. The minimum new-business size for the structured-portfolio programme is R150,000 per bundle. Sources: Evolve Product Range Summary; Evolve Investment Account Dimension; Evolve Intermediary Remuneration Dimension; 2025 Evolve structured-portfolios IPAC paper.

name: Liberty Flexible Investment Plan
description: Capital bond, single premium, bundled policies, flexible access, tiered management fees
spec_notes: Previously called the Excelsior 600 Capital Bond. It is a single-premium unit-linked capital bond with an initial five-year term and is open-ended thereafter. It may be structured as a bundle of policies for greater flexibility. Management fees are tiered according to the total investment value across the bundle. The retrieved sources did not expose the complete fee tiers or a verified minimum initial premium, so those numeric fields remain blank. Sources: Liberty Investment Products pre-Excelsior 1000 Summary Article; Excelsior Investment Plan and Flexible Investment Plan Product Summary; Compass Product and Prototype Codes.

name: STASH by Liberty
description: Tax-free savings, app based, Top 40, Cash+, flexible contributions
spec_notes: STASH is a tax-free investment proposition. The retrieved approval material describes a fee charged on contributions rather than a traditional annual AUM or platform fee, but the precise contribution-fee percentage was not exposed in the retrieved snippet. The supplied contribution information is retained: no formal minimum and automatic contributions from R5 per day. Sources: STASH fees IPAC submission; Liberty Report to Society 2023; supplied products.csv.

name: Liberty Offshore Investment Plan
description: Offshore endowment, lump sum, foreign currency, global portfolios, phased investment
spec_notes: A single lump-sum offshore endowment with an initial five-year term and open-ended thereafter. Up to seven portfolios may be selected, ranging from money-market to specialist equity funds, and phasing-in is available. Minimum initial investment is USD15,000; minimum per portfolio is USD100; minimum additional investment is USD1,000. Initial advice fee is negotiable up to 5% excluding VAT. The retrieved platform-fee tiers include 0.35% p.a. for investment values of USD75,000 and above and 0.25% p.a. for USD200,000 and above; the annual_platform_fee_pct field records the higher disclosed tier. No foreign-currency fee or upfront asset-swap charge applies. Sources: Liberty Offshore Investment Plan; Premium Dimension; Product Charges and Fees Dimension.

name: SaveUp Account
description: Cash, money market, capital stability, liquidity
spec_notes: Separate investable cash-account record mapped to the Liberty Cash Tracker. The Liberty Cash Tracker portfolio charge is 0.05% p.a. The product-level platform fee, advice fee and minimum investment were not specified for this separate cash-account construct, so those fields remain blank. Sources: Agile Investment Account Dimension; Liberty Evolve Investment Plan and Sinking Funds portfolio specification; supplied product mapping.
